USD-equivalent conversion basis for every converted PLN amount: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rate dated 2026-08-18 (EUR 1 = USD 1.1576; EUR 1 = PLN 4.3190), fetched 2026-08-18 from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml (Cube time='2026-08-18') — derived 1 PLN = USD 0.268048 (USD per PLN = 1.1576 / 4.3190); equivalently 1 USD = 3.73122 PLN. Every venue rate_estimate_note records this dated basis. No FX rate is invented; where no dated conversion basis exists the USD equivalent stays null with a question.
